manifest.name: dsh-lit-filecheck
manifest.description: lit + FileCheck 测试闭环：lit_run 统计并定位失败 CHECK、lit_rerun_failed 只重跑失败集、filecheck 单独校验 testFile+irFile

scripts.test: node --test --test-isolation=none test/config.test.mjs test/text.test.mjs test/diag.test.mjs test/lit.test.mjs test/filecheck.test.mjs test/exec.test.mjs test/tools.test.mjs test/plugin.test.mjs test/integration.test.mjs

manifest.author: Rcyc-1025

bundle.text:
# dsh-lit-filecheck：lit 测试运行 + FileCheck 断言定位 + 失败重跑。
#
# 三个工具（lit_run / lit_rerun_failed / filecheck）总是会被注册：插件加载阶段不探测工具链，
# 也不会因为缺少 lit 或 FileCheck 而加载失败。只有在真正需要外部程序时才解析路径；
# 解析不到就返回 ok:false + 中文 hint（绝不抛异常）。
#
# lit 查找顺序：config.litCommand（argv 数组，最高优先级）> config.litPath（.py 自动配 python，
# .cmd/.bat 直接拒绝）> toolchain.json 的 llvm.mlirRoot/bin/llvm-lit.py >
# llvm.root/bin/llvm-lit.py > 常见绝对安装位置 > PATH 上的 llvm-lit。
#
# toolchain.json 查找顺序：config.toolchainPath > 环境变量 MLIR_TOOLCHAIN_JSON >
# 会话 cwd/mlir-lang/toolchain.json。
- insert:
    - id: lit-filecheck
      name: 'dsh-lit-filecheck'
      config:
        timeoutMs: 120000
        maxOutputBytes: 1048576
        maxChecks: 50
        logDir: .lit-logs
        requireFileCheck: true

readme.text: A DSH plugin that brings the **lit + FileCheck** test loop into a session. Three tools:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `lit_run` | Runs `llvm-lit` in a suite root and reports total/passed/failed/skipped, splitting each failure block into per-CHECK diagnostics: which line holds the CHECK, which line of the actual IR broke it |
| `lit_rerun_failed` | Re-runs only the tests that failed in this plugin instance's previous `lit_run` (no full-suite rescan) |
| `filecheck` | Runs FileCheck once on an explicit pair of "test file with CHECK lines + actual IR file" and reports match/mismatch with the offending lines |
Plugin id `lit-filecheck`, npm package `dsh-lit-filecheck@0.1.0`, ESM, no background jobs and no persisted state (the rerun target lives in plugin-instance memory only).

As a bundle, `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin entry:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: lit-filecheck
      name: 'dsh-lit-filecheck'
      config:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toolchainPath` | — | Path to `toolchain.json`. Lookup order: this key > `MLIR_TOOLCHAIN_JSON` > `<session cwd>/mlir-lang/toolchain.json` |
| `litCommand` | — | Full argv array for lit, highest priority, e.g. `["D:/Code/python/python.exe","D:/Code/llvm-build/bin/llvm-lit.py"]`. No probing when set |
| `litPath` | — | Path to `llvm-lit.py` or an executable. A `.py` file gets `pythonPath` prepended; `.cmd` / `.bat` are rejected (cmd forwarding mangles arguments on Windows) |
| `pythonPath` | — | Interpreter for the `.py` lit; otherwise `D:/Code/python/python.exe` and PATH are tried |
| `filecheckPath` | — | `FileCheck.exe`; otherwise searched in `llvmRoot/bin`, `D:/Code/llvm-build/bin`, `D:/Code/llvm/bin`, PATH |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Total budget for one lit run. **Recommend >= 1000**; the floor is 1 only so the timeout path stays acceptance-testable |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `1048576` | Per-stream retention cap for stdout and stderr (truncated + warned when exceeded) |
| `maxChecks` | `50` | Maximum CHECK diagnostics parsed per run |
| `logDir` | `.lit-logs` | Log directory, relative to the session cwd |
| `requireFileCheck` | `tr
Out-of-range numbers never throw: one warning plus fallback to the default.

Parameters: `suiteDir` (required), `filter`, `jobs` (1–64), `timeoutMs`.

Command (cwd = `suiteDir`):

```
<litCommand...> -v --no-progress-bar --show-unsupported [--filter=<filter>] [-j <jobs>] .
```

Result fields:

```
ok, total, passed, failed, skipped,
failures: [{ test, status, reason, runLine,
             checks: [{ checkFile, line, column, prefix, pattern,
                        expected, matched, actualLine, actualText, message }],

`ok` is `true` only when preflight passed, exit code is 0, `failed === 0`, and the run did not time out. A failing run still returns complete `failures` / `checks` / `logPath` — a red run is the informative one.

`reason` ∈ `filecheck-mismatch` (CHECK diagnostics present), `command-failed`, `timeout`, `no-filecheck-diagnostic`, `unknown`.

Parameters: `testFile`, `irFile` (both required, existing regular files), `extraArgs`, `timeoutMs` (default 30000).

```
<FileCheck.exe> --color=false <extraArgs...> <testFile> --input-file=<irFile>
```

`extraArgs` containing `--input-file` or `-` is rejected (`invalid-extra-args`) because it would override `irFile`.
Returns `ok, mismatches[], stdout, stderr, truncated, logPath, durationMs, error, hint`; only exit code 0 gives `ok:true`. No CHECK directives at all is `no-check-lines`, never a guessed "pass".

```
<check-file>:<line>:<column>: error: CHECK: expected string not found in input
```

The plugin reads line `<line>` of the test file as `pattern` and the text after `CHECK:` as `expected`; `actualLine` / `actualText` come from the first available note: `note: possible intended match located ...` first, then `note: scanning from here`. **When neither note exists they stay `null` — nothing is invented.**
Crash dumps (`PLEASE submit a bug report` / `Stack dump`) never masquerade as diagnostics; they go to the log and `warnings` only.

`invalid-input`, `path-not-found`, `not-a-directory`, `tool-missing`, `spawn-failed`, `timeout`, `lit-internal-error`, `no-previous-run`, `invalid-extra-args`, `no-check-lines`, `log-write-failed`, `parse-failed`.

Failures are returned as `ok:false` + `error{code,message}` + an actionable Chinese `hint`; nothing throws.

The full output is written to `<logDir>/lit-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>-<rand>.log` with argv, cwd, start/end time, exit code, counts, failure details, and complete stdout/stderr. The stdout/stderr in the tool result are clipped to `maxOutputBytes` (head and tail kept). If the log cannot be written, `logPath:null` plus a `log-write-failed` warning — the result itself is still returned.

```powershell
npm test        # 68 cases: 66 pass, 2 real-lit cases skipped by default
npm run smoke   # smoke: really runs the plain suite and prints all three results
```

Real lit integration tests are skipped by default; run them with:

```powershell
$env:LIT_FILECHECK_REAL='1'; node --test --test-isolation=none test/integration.test.mjs
```

Verification status (this machine, 2026-11-05, LLVM 23.1.4):

- **lit side verified for real**: `test/fixtures/plain/` has 5 tests, 3 pass and 2 fail; `lit_run` reports total=5/passed=3/failed=2 and `lit_rerun_failed` runs exactly those 2. Failure-block parsing is calibrated against captured real output in `test/golden/plain-lit-output.txt`.
- **FileCheck side not verified against a real binary**: this machine's Windows LLVM 23.1.4 package ships no `FileCheck.exe`, and there is no MSVC toolchain to build one. CHECK-level parsing (`line` → the CHECK line, `actualLine` → the actual IR line) is covered by hand-written `test/golden/filecheck-stderr.txt` and `test/golden/lit-filecheck-output.txt` following spec §9.3. Re-run a real CHECK-level acceptance once FileCheck is available.

- **`lit.cfg.py` must be pure ASCII**: on Windows lit reads config files with the platform locale (GBK) and dies on non-ASCII comments with `UnicodeDecodeError`.
- A `.cmd` / `.bat` `llvm-lit` is rejected on purpose; use `llvm-lit.py` + `pythonPath`.
- Under the DSH restricted sandbox, piped Node spawns are denied (`spawn EPERM`) and lit's multiprocessing pool hits `PermissionError`; the tools then return `spawn-failed`. Host-side runs work normally.

DSH 插件：把 **lit + FileCheck** 的测试闭环接进会话。三个工具——

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `lit_run` | 在 lit suite 根目录跑 `llvm-lit`，给出 total/passed/failed/skipped，并把失败块里的 CHECK 诊断逐条拆成「CHECK 在哪一行、实际 IR 在哪一行」 |
| `lit_rerun_failed` | 只重跑本插件实例上一次 `lit_run` 里失败的用例（不重新扫描整个 suite） |
| `filecheck` | 单独跑一次 FileCheck：给定「含 CHECK 的测试文件 + 实际 IR 文件」，直接告诉你匹不匹配、不匹配时差在哪一行 |

插件 id `lit-filecheck`，npm 包 `dsh-lit-filecheck@0.1.0`，ESM，无后台任务、无持久化状态（重跑目标只存在插件实例内存里）。

作为 bundle 安装时，`cordis.patch.yml` 会插入插件条目：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: lit-filecheck
      name: 'dsh-lit-filecheck'
      config:

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toolchainPath` | — | `toolchain.json` 路径。查找顺序：本项 > 环境变量 `MLIR_TOOLCHAIN_JSON` > 会话 cwd 下 `mlir-lang/toolchain.json` |
| `litCommand` | — | lit 的完整 argv 数组，优先级最高，例如 `["D:/Code/python/python.exe","D:/Code/llvm-build/bin/llvm-lit.py"]`。配置了就不再探测 |
| `litPath` | — | `llvm-lit.py` 或可执行文件路径。`.py` 会自动拼上 `pythonPath`；`.cmd` / `.bat` 一律拒绝（Windows 上经 cmd 转发会把参数弄脏） |
| `pythonPath` | — | 跑 `.py` 版 lit 用的解释器；不填则依次试 `D:/Code/python/python.exe` 与 PATH |
| `filecheckPath` | — | `FileCheck.exe` 路径；不填则在 `llvmRoot/bin`、`D:/Code/llvm-build/bin`、`D:/Code/llvm/bin`、PATH 里找 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次 lit 的总预算；**推荐 >= 1000**，下限放到 1 只为让「超时路径」可被真实验收 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `1048576` | stdout、stderr 各自的保留上限（超了截断并告警） |
| `maxChecks` | `50` | 每次运行最多解析多少条 CHECK 诊断 |
| `logDir` | `.lit-logs` | 相对会话 cwd 的日志目录 |
| `requireFileCheck` | `true` | 为 `true` 时找不到 FileCheck 直接 `tool-missing`；为 `false` 时只告警并继续跑 lit（此时失败块通常没有 CHECK 诊断） |
数值越界不会抛异常：只记一条 warning 并回落默认值。

参数：`suiteDir`（必填）、`filter`、`jobs`（1–64）、`timeoutMs`。

实际执行的命令（cwd = `suiteDir`）：

```
<litCommand...> -v --no-progress-bar --show-unsupported [--filter=<filter>] [-j <jobs>] .
```

返回字段：

```
ok, total, passed, failed, skipped,
failures: [{ test, status, reason, runLine,
             checks: [{ checkFile, line, column, prefix, pattern,
                        expected, matched, actualLine, actualText, message }],

`ok` 为 `true` 需要同时满足：预检通过、退出码 0、`failed === 0`、未超时。有测试失败时 `ok:false`，但 `failures` / `checks` / `logPath` 都是完整的——失败的运行恰恰是信息量最大的那种。

`reason` 取值：`filecheck-mismatch`（有 CHECK 诊断）、`command-failed`（命令/编译失败）、`timeout`、`no-filecheck-diagnostic`、`unknown`。

无参数。命令行只带上次失败的路径，**不带 `--filter`**：

```
<litCommand...> -v --no-progress-bar <失败测试路径...>
```

- 上次没有失败用例 → `ok:true, noop:true, total:0`，不启动 lit；
- 从未调用过 `lit_run` → `no-previous-run`；
- 失败文件已被删除 → 进 `missingTests` 并告警，全都没了则是 `path-not-found`；
- 输出结构同 `lit_run`，额外带 `onlyFailed` / `noop` / `source{suiteDir,startedAt}` / `missingTests`。

参数：`testFile`、`irFile`（都必填，须是已存在的普通文件）、`extraArgs`、`timeoutMs`（默认 30000）。

命令：

```
<FileCheck.exe> --color=false <extraArgs...> <testFile> --input-file=<irFile>
```

`extraArgs` 里出现 `--input-file` 或 `-` 会被拒绝（`invalid-extra-args`），因为那会覆盖 `irFile`。

返回 `ok, mismatches[], stdout, stderr, truncated, logPath, durationMs, error, hint`；只有退出码 0 才是 `ok:true`。找不到任何 CHECK 指令时是 `no-check-lines`，而不是猜成「通过」。

CHECK 诊断行是：

```
<check-file>:<line>:<column>: error: CHECK: expected string not found in input
```

插件据此回读测试文件第 `<line>` 行作为 `pattern`、取 `CHECK:` 之后的文本作为 `expected`；`actualLine` / `actualText` 依次从两条 note 里取：优先 `note: possible intended match located ...`，其次 `note: scanning from here`。**两条 note 都没有就是 `null`，绝不编造。**

崩溃栈（`PLEASE submit a bug report` / `Stack dump`）不会伪装成诊断，只写进日志与 `warnings`。

`invalid-input`、`path-not-found`、`not-a-directory`、`tool-missing`、`spawn-failed`、`timeout`、`lit-internal-error`、`no-previous-run`、`invalid-extra-args`、`no-check-lines`、`log-write-failed`、`parse-failed`。

失败一律以 `ok:false` + `error{code,message}` + 中文可执行 `hint` 返回，不抛异常。

完整输出写到 `<logDir>/lit-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>-<rand>.log`，包含 argv、cwd、起止时间、退出码、计数、失败详情与完整 stdout/stderr。工具返回里的 stdout/stderr 按 `maxOutputBytes` 截断（保留头尾）。日志写不进去时 `logPath:null` + 一条 `log-write-failed` 告警，工具照常返回结果。

```powershell
npm test        # 68 个用例：66 通过、2 个真实 lit 用例默认 skip
npm run smoke   # 冒烟：真跑 plain suite，打印三项结果
```

真实 lit 集成测试默认跳过，本机运行方式：

```powershell
$env:LIT_FILECHECK_REAL='1'; node --test --test-isolation=none test/integration.test.mjs
```

验证状态（本机 2026-11-05，LLVM 23.1.4）：

- lit 侧**真实跑通**：`test/fixtures/plain/` 5 个用例 3 过 2 挂，`lit_run` 得到 total=5/passed=3/failed=2，`lit_rerun_failed` 只跑那 2 个；失败块解析用真机输出 `test/golden/plain-lit-output.txt` 校准。
- FileCheck 侧**未用真机验证**：本机 LLVM 23.1.4 的 Windows 包里没有 `FileCheck.exe`，MSVC 工具链也不在，无法就地构建。CHECK 级解析（`line` 指向 CHECK 行、`actualLine` 指向实际 IR 行）用手写的 `test/golden/filecheck-stderr.txt`、`test/golden/lit-filecheck-output.txt` 覆盖，格式按规格 §9.3。补齐 FileCheck 后应补跑一次真机 CHECK 级验收。

- **`lit.cfg.py` 必须纯 ASCII**：Windows 上 lit 用平台 locale（GBK）读配置文件，中文注释会直接 `UnicodeDecodeError`。
- `.cmd` / `.bat` 版的 `llvm-lit` 不被接受，请用 `llvm-lit.py` + `pythonPath`。
- 在 DSH 的受限沙箱里，Node 的管道式 spawn 会被拒（`spawn EPERM`），lit 的多进程池也会 `PermissionError`；此时工具返回 `spawn-failed`。宿主侧运行正常。
